question: How many orders are there for each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the gross revenue for each month?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;

question: Show monthly sales by product.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month, p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) GROUP BY order_month, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY order_month, gross_revenue_cents DESC;

question: What are the top 10 products by gross revenue?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY gross_revenue_cents DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List customers with their order dates and totals.
sql: SELECT c.full_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 100;

question: What is the average order value for each customer region?
sql: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.total_amount_cents) AS average_order_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY average_order_cents DESC;

question: How many orders were placed last month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND order_date < date('now', 'start of month');

question: Show delivery times for delivered shipments.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at, julianday(s.delivered_at) - julianday(s.shipped_at) AS delivery_days FROM shipments AS s JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) WHERE s.status = 'delivered' ORDER BY delivery_days DESC LIMIT 100;

question: List products with their category names.
sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.name AS category_name FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) ORDER BY c.name, p.product_name LIMIT 100;

question: How many customers are there in each country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: What are the total sales of Apparel?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS total_sales_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) WHERE LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%apparel%' OR LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%apparel%';

question: What are the total sales of products matching Classic?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS total_sales_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) WHERE LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%classic%';

question: What is the total revenue for each product category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY gross_revenue_cents DESC;

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: What is the average product price in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, AVG(p.unit_price_cents) AS average_price_cents FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY average_price_cents DESC;

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders;

question: List all product category names.
sql: SELECT name, description FROM categories ORDER BY name LIMIT 100;

question: List customers in the North region.
sql: SELECT customer_id, full_name, region, country FROM customers WHERE LOWER(region) LIKE '%north%' ORDER BY full_name LIMIT 100;

question: What are the 10 most expensive products?
sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price_cents FROM products ORDER BY unit_price_cents DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show cancelled orders.
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Who are the top 10 customers by total spend?
sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(o.total_amount_cents) AS total_spend_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spend_cents DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many orders were placed from each country?
sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total charged amount for each payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount_cents) AS charged_cents FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'charge' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY charged_cents DESC;

question: What is the total refunded amount?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'refund';

question: How many shipments does each carrier handle?
sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipment_count DESC;

question: Which products sold the most units?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average number of items per order?
sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) AS average_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: List orders with the customer name and order status.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.full_name, o.status, o.order_date FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Show the products and quantities in each order.
sql: SELECT oi.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.line_total_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) ORDER BY oi.order_id LIMIT 100;

question: List shipments with the customer name and carrier.
sql: SELECT s.shipment_id, c.full_name, s.carrier, s.status FROM shipments AS s JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) ORDER BY s.shipped_at DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Which customers bought Electronics products?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN categories AS cat USING (category_id) WHERE LOWER(cat.name) LIKE '%electronics%' ORDER BY c.full_name LIMIT 100;

question: Show refund payments with the related order status.
sql: SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_id, o.status, p.amount_cents, p.paid_at FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) WHERE p.payment_type = 'refund' ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC LIMIT 100;

question: How many orders were placed in each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year;

question: What was the gross revenue last quarter?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3 + 3) || ' months') AND o.order_date < date('now', 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months');

question: How many customers signed up each month?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_month;

question: What is the average delivery time in days for each carrier?
sql: SELECT carrier, AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) AS average_delivery_days FROM shipments WHERE status = 'delivered' GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY average_delivery_days;

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01';
